adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces an `afterRender` scheduled callback in `embeddable-host` (`_focusOnInput`) that calls `this.$('.host-name').focus()` without checking `isDestroying/isDestroyed`. Since the component can be removed via actions like `cancel` (new host) or `deleteHost` (controller removes it from `embedding.embeddable_hosts`), there is a plausible lifecycle race where the callback runs after teardown, leading to DOM access on a destroyed component (often at least a warning; depending on Ember/debug settings it can assert). The diff doesn’t definitively prove an exception will occur, but it does introduce an unguarded async DOM interaction worth fixing for robustness.
